name: evercraft
description: Inspect public websites and connect ChatGPT or Codex to the Evercraft/Systemia capability fabric through one truthful, permission-aware front door.

interface.longDescription: Inspect a user-supplied public website with a bounded, evidence-backed preview, or route a real problem to the smallest truthful Evercraft capability. Evercraft preserves evidence, availability, and authorization boundaries. Preview and discovery do not grant private access, payment authority, publishing authority, deployment authority, or permission for consequential actions.
defaultPrompt: Preview this public website and show me the basic signals that need attention.
Find the smallest Evercraft capability for this problem.
Show me the safest next step Evercraft can actually perform.
